source.title: Night City 2045
source.note: Direct source review of all eleven NorCal Military Base rows the v0.2 audit classified CONTEXT_ONLY. Factual metadata and concise paraphrases only; source prose is not reproduced.

entities.name: 157th Tactical Air Squadron Airfield
entities.source_summary: Military airfield used to park and maintain the 157th Tactical Air Squadron's eclectic aircraft fleet; no customer-facing service or sales are stated.

entities.name: Estero Bay Military COG Academy
entities.source_summary: On-base school and emergency shelter serving children of base personnel; the source does not establish paid public education or commerce.

entities.name: Fire & Emergency Response Center
entities.source_summary: Military emergency-response facility handling fires, hazardous-material incidents and medical emergencies on base with its own response vehicles.

entities.name: Main Gate
entities.source_summary: Fortified credential-control point and the only ordinary visitor entrance to the base; no commercial service is described.

entities.name: Mess Hall
entities.source_summary: Large military dining facility feeding base personnel; meals are part of base support rather than a public customer-facing restaurant.

entities.name: Military Police Headquarters
entities.source_summary: Headquarters, garage, armory, laboratories and detention facilities for the base Military Police; no public commerce is stated.

entities.name: Militech Corporate Housing
entities.source_summary: Employer-provided housing for Militech personnel near the base gate, including an executive cigar lounge; no public rental operation is stated.

entities.name: Motor Pool
entities.source_summary: Military vehicle-maintenance complex that also repairs base residents' personal vehicles for a small fee, sometimes waived according to rank.

services.label: Personal vehicle repair for base residents
services.pricing_note: Small fee; may be waived by rank

entities.name: Parade Ground
entities.source_summary: Military drill ground that doubles as a park and contains a chapel, practice firing range and bandstand; no paid public service is stated.

entities.name: The Potentilla
entities.source_summary: Headquarters complex for several military units and a memorial columbarium; no customer-facing commerce is described.

entities.name: Task Force 384 Docks
entities.source_summary: Military docks and training infrastructure for Task Force 384, including the stationary carrier NCS John F. Kennedy; no public service is stated.
